problems.text: Hermes runs v0.22.2, a minor release behind upstream v0.23.4, and the Dockerfile cannot build on the new base because its uv path is gone.
The `medium-reader` skill calls `browser_navigate` and `browser_snapshot`, which v0.23.0 removed.

goals.text: Run the current upstream Hermes with memory, models, voice notes and crons still working.
Keep every skill able to reach the tools it names.

outcomes.change: The hermes image builds on v0.23.4 and the job runs healthy on 0.23.4-1
outcomes.checked_by: `just rebuild_hermes`, the new deployment's health, `openviking_tools` in the gateway log, a `viking_search` returning `lab` memories, a transcribed voice note, `/cron list`, and `uv run --directory cli pytest`
a grep finding no removed `browser_*` tool name under `deployments/applications/services/hermes`, and one medium-reader run on the new image
